0022600118.text: The Grizzlies (1-0, second in the Southwest and sixth in the West) visit the Kings (0-1, fourth in the Pacific and 14th in the West), with Memphis on a one-game winning streak. Memphis will be without Cedric Coward, who is out with a wrist sprain and has averaged 7.0 points and 27.8 minutes per game this season, while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and Memphis won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 123-114 Grizzlies loss in Memphis on February 23, 2026.
